features: Performance Center daily and Frozen Snapshot table headers are clickable sortable columns with ascending/descending indicators.
Frozen Snapshot date display is simplified to M/D (for example 9/1); sorting still uses the full checkpoint timestamp internally.
Cloudflare 4H auto analysis still runs every four hours for Crypto + US-stock, but ordinary runs now update latest/ only and no longer keep full snapshot files under runs/.
The Taiwan 04:01 auto batch is explicitly marked from ScheduledController.scheduledTime and stores the only durable daily market snapshots under runs/champion/YYYY-MM-DD_0401/.
Adds GET /api/champion/checkpoint?market=crypto|us-stock&date=YYYY-MM-DD for HistoricalTraining 08:25 settlement/freeze ingestion.
On a 04:01 checkpoint upload, legacy large runs/*/snapshot_ai.json and snapshot_us_stock_ai.json objects are cleaned from R2; small run status JSON remains for runtime diagnostics.
The top-bar 近期戰績 link opens performance.html in a new browser tab via target=_blank.
Performance Center evolution threshold fallback is updated from 200 to 120 settled 72H Frozen Champion cases.
Performance Center adds ALL / CRYPTO / US_STOCK market tabs; S-state cards, probability calibration, daily records, and detail records follow the selected market.
Per-snapshot detail table now shows market type so Crypto and US-stock live learning can be audited separately.
Removes the Champion vs Challenger competition panel from the main Terminal UI.
Adds a top-bar 近期戰績 link that opens a dedicated Champion performance center.
Performance Center reads HistoricalTraining Frozen Champion performance.json and ledger.jsonl without recomputing old predictions.
Shows SUCCESS, ALIVE_SLOW, TRUE_FAIL, OTHER, success rate, structural survival rate, and true-fail rate for S0.5 / S1 / S2 / S3.
Validates predicted success probability thresholds at >=60%, >=65%, and >=70% against actual 72H success.
Shows per-day settlement records and per-snapshot 12H / 24H / 48H / 72H outcomes, state path, MFE and MAE.
Keeps the Active Champion model loaded on the main page for existing probability/sample-tier rendering; only Challenger UI/data polling is retired.
Cloudflare 08:25 scheduling, full-analysis scheduling, ADX 1-decimal sticky semantics, S-state rules, probability engine, and trading scan logic are unchanged.
